# Ignite UI for Blazor Lite v1.0.1 — Full API Reference

> Complete API reference for the Ignite UI for Blazor Lite package (1.0.1). This file lists all public classes, interfaces, enumerations, type aliases, functions, and variables with their signatures, parameters, and descriptions.

Platform: Blazor
Package: IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite
Version: 1.0.1

## Classes

### [_Imports](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/_Imports)

- **constructor**(): void
- **Execute**(): void

### [IgbAccordion](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbAccordion)
The Accordion is a container-based component that can house multiple expansion panels and offers keyboard navigation.

- **constructor**(): void
- **Closed**: `EventCallback<IgbExpansionPanelComponentEventArgs>` — Emitted after a child expansion panel is closed.
- **ClosedScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **Closing**: `EventCallback<IgbExpansionPanelComponentEventArgs>` — Emitted before closing a child expansion panel.
- **ClosingScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **Opened**: `EventCallback<IgbExpansionPanelComponentEventArgs>` — Emitted after a child expansion panel is opened.
- **OpenedScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **Opening**: `EventCallback<IgbExpansionPanelComponentEventArgs>` — Emitted before opening a child expansion panel.
- **OpeningScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **SingleExpand**: `bool` — Allows only one panel to be expanded at a time.
- **EnsureModulesLoaded**(): void — Requests the client modules this component needs; override to register more through .
- **HideAll**(): void — Hides all of the child expansion panels' contents.
- **HideAllAsync**(): Task — Hides all of the child expansion panels' contents.
- **ShowAll**(): void — Shows all of the child expansion panels' contents.
- **ShowAllAsync**(): Task — Shows all of the child expansion panels' contents.

### [IgbActiveStepChangedEventArgs](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbActiveStepChangedEventArgs)
Event arguments for the event, raised after the active step has changed.

- **constructor**(): void
- **Detail**: `IgbActiveStepChangedEventArgsDetail` — The payload of the event, carrying the index of the step that became active.

### [IgbActiveStepChangedEventArgsDetail](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbActiveStepChangedEventArgsDetail)
The payload of the event.

- **constructor**(): void
- **Index**: `double` — The index of the step that became active.

### [IgbActiveStepChangingEventArgs](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbActiveStepChangingEventArgs)
Event arguments for the event, raised before the active step changes.

- **constructor**(): void
- **Detail**: `IgbActiveStepChangingEventArgsDetail` — The payload of the event, carrying the index of the currently active step and the index of the step that is about to become active.

### [IgbActiveStepChangingEventArgsDetail](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbActiveStepChangingEventArgsDetail)
The payload of the event.

- **constructor**(): void
- **NewIndex**: `double` — The index of the step that is about to become active.
- **OldIndex**: `double` — The index of the step that is currently active.

### [IgbAvatar](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbAvatar)
An avatar component is used as a representation of a user identity typically in a user profile.

- **constructor**(): void
- **Alt**: `string` — Alternative text for the image.
- **Initials**: `string` — Initials to use as a fallback when no image is available.
- **Shape**: `AvatarShape` — The shape of the avatar.
- **Src**: `string` — The image source to use.
- **EnsureModulesLoaded**(): void — Requests the client modules this component needs; override to register more through .

### [IgbBadge](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbBadge)
The badge is a component indicating a status on a related item or an area where some active indication is required.

- **constructor**(): void
- **Dot**: `bool` — Sets whether to render a dot type badge. When enabled, the badge appears as a small dot without any content.
- **Outlined**: `bool` — Sets whether to draw an outlined version of the badge.
- **Shape**: `BadgeShape` — The shape of the badge.
- **Variant**: `StyleVariant` — The type (style variant) of the badge.
- **EnsureModulesLoaded**(): void — Requests the client modules this component needs; override to register more through .

### [IgbBanner](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbBanner)
A non-modal notification banner that displays important, concise messages requiring user acknowledgement. The banner slides into view with an animated grow transition and renders inline, pushing the surrounding page content rather than overlaying it.

- **constructor**(): void
- **Closed**: `EventCallback<IgbVoidEventArgs>` — Emitted after the banner has fully closed and its exit animation has completed.
- **ClosedScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **Closing**: `EventCallback<IgbVoidEventArgs>` — Emitted just before the banner closes in response to the default action button being clicked.
- **ClosingScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **Open**: `bool` — Whether the banner is open. Setting this property programmatically will immediately show or hide the banner without animation and without emitting close events. Prefer the , , and methods for animated transitions.
- **EnsureModulesLoaded**(): void — Requests the client modules this component needs; override to register more through .
- **Hide**(): bool — Closes the banner with an animated grow-out transition.
- **HideAsync**(): Task<bool> — Closes the banner with an animated grow-out transition.
- **Show**(): bool — Opens the banner with an animated grow-in transition.
- **ShowAsync**(): Task<bool> — Opens the banner with an animated grow-in transition.
- **Toggle**(): bool — Toggles the banner open or closed depending on its current state. Equivalent to calling when closed and when open.
- **ToggleAsync**(): Task<bool> — Toggles the banner open or closed depending on its current state. Equivalent to calling when closed and when open.

### [IgbBannerModule](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbBannerModule)

- **constructor**(): void
- **Register**(runtime: IIgniteUIBlazor): void — Requests this module's client resources to be loaded into the runtime.

### [IgbBaseAlertLike](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbBaseAlertLike)
Base class shared by and .

- **constructor**(): void
- **DisplayTime**: `double` — Determines the duration in milliseconds in which the component will be visible.
- **KeepOpen**: `bool` — Determines whether the component should close after the is over.
- **Open**: `bool` — Whether the component is in shown state.
- **Position**: `AbsolutePosition` — Sets the position of the component in the viewport. - positions the component at the bottom. This is the default. - positions the component at the center. - positions the component at the top.
- **Positioning**: `NotificationPositioning` — Sets the positioning strategy of the component. - positions the component relative to the viewport, ignoring any ancestor elements. This is the default behavior. - positions the component relative to the nearest visible ancestor. In this mode, the component will be constrained within the bounding box of the ancestor and will be positioned according to the property.
- **Hide**(): bool — Closes the component.
- **HideAsync**(): Task<bool> — Closes the component.
- **Show**(): bool — Opens the component.
- **ShowAsync**(): Task<bool> — Opens the component.
- **Toggle**(): bool — Toggles the open state of the component.
- **ToggleAsync**(): Task<bool> — Toggles the open state of the component.

### [IgbBreadcrumb](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbBreadcrumb)
A single item in an navigation trail.

- **constructor**(): void
- **Current**: `bool` — Marks the item as the current page and sets aria-current="page" on it.
- **Disabled**: `bool` — Disables the item. Sets aria-disabled="true" on it and removes the slotted content from the tab sequence.
- **EnsureModulesLoaded**(): void — Requests the client modules this component needs; override to register more through .

### [IgbBreadcrumbs](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbBreadcrumbs)
A navigation trail that renders an ordered list of items.

- **constructor**(): void
- **Separator**: `string` — The name of the icon rendered as the separator between the items. When not set, the tree_expand icon is used. An item overrides it with content in its separator slot.
- **EnsureModulesLoaded**(): void — Requests the client modules this component needs; override to register more through .

### [IgbButton](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbButton)
Represents a clickable button, used to submit forms or anywhere in a document for accessible, standard button functionality. The button supports multiple visual variants, can render as an anchor (<a>) element when is set, and is fully form-associated, acting as a native submit or reset control.

- **constructor**(): void
- **Variant**: `ButtonVariant` — The variant of the button which determines its visual appearance. – filled background; highest visual emphasis (default). – transparent background with a visible border. – no background or border; lowest visual emphasis. – floating action button shape; typically used for primary actions.
- **EnsureModulesLoaded**(): void — Requests the client modules this component needs; override to register more through .

### [IgbButtonBase](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbButtonBase)
Base class shared by and .

- **constructor**(): void
- **Blur**: `EventCallback<IgbVoidEventArgs>` — Emitted when the component loses focus.
- **BlurScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **Command**: `string` — The command to invoke on the target element specified by . Part of the Invoker Commands API. Custom commands must start with two dashes (e.g. --my-command).
- **Commandfor**: `string` — The ID of the target element for the invoker command. Part of the Invoker Commands API.
- **Disabled**: `bool` — When set, the button will be disabled and non-interactive.
- **DisplayType**: `ButtonBaseType` — The type of the button, which determines its behavior and semantics. — no default action. — submits the associated form when clicked. — resets the associated form fields to their initial values. Ignored when the button is rendered as a link (i.e. is set).
- **Download**: `string` — Prompts the browser to download the linked resource rather than navigating to it. The optional value is used as the suggested file name. Only effective when is set.
- **Focus**: `EventCallback<IgbVoidEventArgs>` — Emitted when the component gains focus.
- **FocusScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **Href**: `string` — The URL the button points to. When set, the component renders as an <a> element instead of a <button>, enabling navigation on click. Use together with , , and for full anchor semantics.
- **Rel**: `string` — The relationship between the current document and the linked URL. Accepts a space-separated list of link types (e.g. noopener noreferrer). Only effective when is set. When is , setting noopener noreferrer is strongly recommended for security.
- **Target**: `ButtonBaseTarget` — Where to open the linked document. Only effective when is set. — current browsing context (default browser behavior). — new tab or window. — parent browsing context; falls back to if none. — top-level browsing context; falls back to if none.
- **BlurComponent**(): void — Removes focus from the button.
- **BlurComponentAsync**(): Task — Removes focus from the button.
- **Click**(): void — Simulates a mouse click on the button, triggering its click handler and any associated form action.
- **ClickAsync**(): Task — Simulates a mouse click on the button, triggering its click handler and any associated form action.
- **FocusComponent**(options: IgbFocusOptions): void — Sets focus on the button.
- **FocusComponentAsync**(options: IgbFocusOptions): Task — Sets focus on the button.

### [IgbButtonGroup](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbButtonGroup)
Groups a series of components together, exposing features such as layout and selection.

- **constructor**(): void
- **Alignment**: `ContentOrientation` — Sets the orientation of the buttons in the group.
- **Deselect**: `EventCallback<IgbComponentValueChangedEventArgs>` — Emitted when a button is deselected through user interaction.
- **DeselectScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **Disabled**: `bool` — Disables all buttons inside the group.
- **Select**: `EventCallback<IgbComponentValueChangedEventArgs>` — Emitted when a button is selected through user interaction.
- **SelectScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **SelectedItems**: `string[]` — Gets or sets the values of the currently selected buttons.
- **Selection**: `ButtonGroupSelection` — Controls the mode of selection for the button group.
- **EnsureModulesLoaded**(): void — Requests the client modules this component needs; override to register more through .

### [IgbCalendar<TValue>](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbCalendar<TValue>)
Represents a calendar that lets users to select a date value in a variety of different ways.

- **constructor**(): void
- **ActiveDate**: `TValue` — Sets the date which is shown in view and is highlighted. By default it is the current date.
- **ActiveView**: `CalendarActiveView` — The current active view of the component.
- **Change**: `EventCallback<IgbComponentDataValueChangedEventArgs>` — Emitted when the calendar changes its value.
- **ChangeScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **FormatOptions**: `IgbCalendarFormatOptions` — The options used to format the months and the weekdays in the calendar views.
- **HeaderOrientation**: `CalendarHeaderOrientation` — The orientation of the calendar header.
- **HideHeader**: `bool` — Whether to render the calendar header part. When is set to the header is always hidden.
- **HideOutsideDays**: `bool` — Whether to hide the dates that do not belong to the current active month.
- **Orientation**: `ContentOrientation` — The orientation of the calendar months when more than one month is being shown.
- **Value**: `TValue` — The current value of the calendar. Used when is set to .
- **ValueChanged**: `EventCallback<TValue>` — Emitted when the Value property changes. Enables two-way binding through .
- **Values**: `TValue[]` — The current values of the calendar. Used when is set to or .
- **ValuesChanged**: `EventCallback<TValue[]>` — Emitted when the Values property changes. Enables two-way binding through .
- **VisibleMonths**: `double` — The number of months displayed in the days view.
- **EnsureModulesLoaded**(): void — Requests the client modules this component needs; override to register more through .
- **GetCurrentValue**(): TValue — Get the current value of the calendar. Used when is set to .
- **GetCurrentValueAsync**(): Task<TValue> — Get the current value of the calendar. Used when is set to .
- **GetCurrentValues**(): TValue[] — Get the current values of the calendar. Used when is set to or .
- **GetCurrentValuesAsync**(): Task<TValue[]> — Get the current values of the calendar. Used when is set to or .

### [IgbCalendarBase](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbCalendarBase)
Base class for .

- **constructor**(): void
- **DisabledDates**: `IgbDateRangeDescriptor[]` — Gets/Sets the disabled dates for the component.
- **Locale**: `string` — Gets/Sets the locale used for formatting and displaying the dates in the component.
- **ResourceStrings**: `IgbCalendarResourceStrings` — The resource strings for localization.
- **Selection**: `CalendarSelection` — Sets the type of selection in the component.
- **ShowWeekNumbers**: `bool` — Whether to show the week numbers.
- **SpecialDates**: `IgbDateRangeDescriptor[]` — Gets/Sets the special dates for the component.
- **WeekStart**: `WeekDays?` — Gets/Sets the first day of the week. When null, the week follows the locale: if set, otherwise the client locale.

### [IgbCalendarFormatOptions](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbCalendarFormatOptions)
The options used to format the months and the weekdays in the calendar views. Set through .

- **constructor**(): void
- **Month**: `string` — The representation of the month names, one of numeric, 2-digit, long, short or narrow. Defaults to long.
- **Weekday**: `string` — The representation of the weekday names, one of long, short or narrow. Defaults to narrow.

### [IgbCalendarModule](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbCalendarModule)

- **constructor**(): void
- **Register**(runtime: IIgniteUIBlazor): void — Requests this module's client resources to be loaded into the runtime.

### [IgbCalendarResourceStrings](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbCalendarResourceStrings)
The localized strings used by the calendar views, exposed through the ResourceStrings property of and .

- **constructor**(): void
- **EndDate**: `string` — Placeholder shown in the calendar header in place of the range end date until one is selected. Defaults to End.
- **NextMonth**: `string` — The accessible label of the navigation button that moves the days view one month forward. Defaults to Next Month.
- **NextYear**: `string` — The accessible label of the navigation button that moves the months view one year forward. Defaults to Next Year.
- **NextYears**: `string` — The accessible label of the navigation button that moves the years view one page forward. Defaults to Next {0} Years, where {0} is the number of years on a page.
- **PreviousMonth**: `string` — The accessible label of the navigation button that moves the days view one month back. Defaults to Previous Month.
- **PreviousYear**: `string` — The accessible label of the navigation button that moves the months view one year back. Defaults to Previous Year.
- **PreviousYears**: `string` — The accessible label of the navigation button that moves the years view one page back. Defaults to Previous {0} Years, where {0} is the number of years on a page.
- **SelectDate**: `string` — Title shown in the calendar header in single selection mode. Defaults to Select Date.
- **SelectMonth**: `string` — The accessible label of the header button that switches the calendar to the months view.
- **SelectRange**: `string` — Title shown in the calendar header in range selection mode. Defaults to Select Range.
- **SelectYear**: `string` — The accessible label of the header button that switches the calendar to the years view.
- **SelectedDate**: `string` — **Deprecated:** This property is not used in the current localization pipeline and has no effect. It will be removed in a future release. The label for the currently selected date.
- **StartDate**: `string` — Placeholder shown in the calendar header in place of the range start date until one is selected. Defaults to Start.
- **WeekLabel**: `string` — The header of the week numbers column in the days view. Defaults to Wk.

### [IgbCarousel](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbCarousel)
Presents a set of components by sequentially displaying a subset of one or more slides.

- **constructor**(): void
- **AnimationType**: `HorizontalTransitionAnimation` — The animation type.
- **DisableLoop**: `bool` — Whether the carousel should skip rotating to the first slide after it reaches the last.
- **DisablePauseOnInteraction**: `bool` — Whether the carousel should ignore user interactions and not pause on them.
- **HideIndicators**: `bool` — Whether the carousel should skip rendering of the indicator controls (dots).
- **HideNavigation**: `bool` — Whether the carousel should skip rendering of the default navigation buttons.
- **IndicatorsLabelFormat**: `string` — The format used to set the aria-label on the carousel indicators. Instances of {0} will be replaced with the index of the corresponding slide.
- **IndicatorsOrientation**: `CarouselIndicatorsOrientation` — Sets the orientation of the indicator controls (dots).
- **Interval**: `double?` — The duration in milliseconds between changing the active slide. When null, the carousel does not play automatically.
- **MaximumIndicatorsCount**: `double` — The maximum number of indicator controls (dots) that can be shown. Defaults to 10.
- **Paused**: `EventCallback<IgbVoidEventArgs>` — Emitted when the carousel enters paused state by a user interaction.
- **PausedScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **Playing**: `EventCallback<IgbVoidEventArgs>` — Emitted when the carousel enters playing state by a user interaction.
- **PlayingScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **SlideChanged**: `EventCallback<IgbNumberEventArgs>` — Emitted when the current active slide is changed either by user interaction or automatic transitioning.
- **SlideChangedScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **SlidesLabelFormat**: `string` — The format used to set the aria-label on the carousel slides and the text displayed when the number of indicators is greater than the maximum indicator count. Instances of {0} will be replaced with the index of the corresponding slide. Instances of {1} will be replaced with the total amount of slides.
- **Vertical**: `bool` — Whether the carousel has vertical alignment.
- **EnsureModulesLoaded**(): void — Requests the client modules this component needs; override to register more through .
- **GetCurrent**(): double — Gets the index of the current active slide.
- **GetCurrentAsync**(): Task<double> — Gets the index of the current active slide.
- **GetIsPaused**(): bool — Gets whether the carousel is in paused state.
- **GetIsPausedAsync**(): Task<bool> — Gets whether the carousel is in paused state.
- **GetIsPlaying**(): bool — Gets whether the carousel is in playing state.
- **GetIsPlayingAsync**(): Task<bool> — Gets whether the carousel is in playing state.
- **GetTotal**(): double — Gets the total number of slides.
- **GetTotalAsync**(): Task<double> — Gets the total number of slides.
- **Next**(): bool — Switches to the next slide, running any animations.
- **NextAsync**(): Task<bool> — Switches to the next slide, running any animations.
- **Pause**(): void — Pauses the rotation of the carousel slides.
- **PauseAsync**(): Task — Pauses the rotation of the carousel slides.
- **Play**(): void — Resumes playing of the carousel slides.
- **PlayAsync**(): Task — Resumes playing of the carousel slides.
- **Prev**(): bool — Switches to the previous slide, running any animations.
- **PrevAsync**(): Task<bool> — Switches to the previous slide, running any animations.
- **Select**(index: double, animationDirection: CarouselAnimationDirection?): bool — Switches to the slide at the specified index, running any animations.
- **SelectAsync**(index: double, animationDirection: CarouselAnimationDirection?): Task<bool> — Switches to the slide at the specified index, running any animations.

### [IgbColorPicker<TValue>](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbColorPicker<TValue>)
Color input component. The user picks a color with the HSV saturation/value canvas, the hue slider and the optional alpha slider, or types a color string: hex, rgb(a), hsl(a) or a named CSS color. Supports pre-defined swatches and the native EyeDropper API, where the browser provides one.

- **constructor**(): void
- **Change**: `EventCallback<IgbColorPickerValueEventArgs<TValue>>` — Emitted when the value of the component is committed.
- **ChangeScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **Closed**: `EventCallback<IgbVoidEventArgs>` — Emitted after closing the picker dropdown.
- **ClosedScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **Closing**: `EventCallback<IgbVoidEventArgs>` — Emitted just before the picker dropdown is closed.
- **ClosingScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **Disabled**: `bool` — The disabled state of the component.
- **Format**: `ColorFormat` — Sets the color format of the string value. A format change renders the value in the new notation. The color does not change, so the component emits no input or change event.
- **HideFormats**: `bool` — Whether to hide the format picker buttons.
- **Input**: `EventCallback<IgbColorPickerValueEventArgs<TValue>>` — Emitted when the value of the component is changed.
- **InputScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **Invalid**: `bool` — Sets the control into invalid state (visual state only).
- **Label**: `string` — The label of the component. In input mode the component forwards the label to the anchor input; in default mode it renders the label as a separate element.
- **Mode**: `ColorPickerMode` — The mode of the color picker. In default mode the anchor is a trigger button; in input mode the anchor is an editable text field with a color swatch prefix that also opens the picker.
- **Name**: `string` — The name of the control, under which its value is submitted with its form. Forms posted to the server, as in static server rendering, bind fields by this name.
- **Opened**: `EventCallback<IgbVoidEventArgs>` — Emitted after the picker dropdown is open.
- **OpenedScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **Opening**: `EventCallback<IgbVoidEventArgs>` — Emitted just before the picker dropdown is open.
- **OpeningScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **Required**: `bool` — Makes the control a required field in a form context.
- **ShowAlpha**: `bool` — Whether to show the alpha slider and input.
- **Swatches**: `string[]` — Pre-defined color strings. The component renders them as clickable swatches below the picker controls. A click on a swatch commits its color as the value.
- **Value**: `TValue` — The selected color. As a string, a CSS color: hex, rgb(a), hsl(a) or a named color. An empty or invalid string clears the picker, which reports its color in the notation, or "" when cleared. As a , null or clears the picker, which reports the same when cleared. In the picker reports whole-number hue, saturation and lightness, so the can be a unit or two per channel off the picked color.
- **ValueChanged**: `EventCallback<TValue>` — Emitted when the property changes. Enables two-way binding through .
- **CheckValidity**(): bool — Checks the validity of the control and emits the invalid event if it is invalid.
- **CheckValidityAsync**(): Task<bool> — Checks the validity of the control and emits the invalid event if it is invalid.
- **EnsureModulesLoaded**(): void — Requests the client modules this component needs; override to register more through .
- **GetCurrentValue**(): TValue — Returns the current value of the component.
- **GetCurrentValueAsync**(): Task<TValue> — Returns the current value of the component.
- **ReportValidity**(): bool — Checks the validity of the control and moves the focus to it if it is not valid.
- **ReportValidityAsync**(): Task<bool> — Checks the validity of the control and moves the focus to it if it is not valid.
- **SetCustomValidity**(message: string): void — Sets a custom validation message for the control. As long as message is not empty, the control is considered invalid.
- **SetCustomValidityAsync**(message: string): Task — Sets a custom validation message for the control. As long as message is not empty, the control is considered invalid.

### [IgbCombo<TValue, TItem>](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbCombo<TValue, TItem>)
The Combo component is similar to in that it provides a list of options from which the user can make a selection. In contrast to the Select component, the Combo component displays all options in a virtualized list of items, meaning the combo box can simultaneously show thousands of options, where one or more options can be selected. Additionally, users can create custom item templates, allowing for robust data visualization. The Combo component features case-sensitive filtering, grouping, complex data binding, dynamic addition of values and more.

- **constructor**(): void
- **Autofocus**: `bool` — The autofocus attribute of the control.
- **AutofocusList**: `bool` — Focuses the list of options when the menu opens.
- **Blur**: `EventCallback<IgbVoidEventArgs>` — Emitted when the component loses focus.
- **BlurScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **CaseSensitiveIcon**: `bool` — Enables the case sensitive search icon in the filtering input.
- **Change**: `EventCallback<IgbComboChangeEventArgs<TValue, TItem>>` — Emitted when the control's selection has changed.
- **ChangeScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **Closed**: `EventCallback<IgbVoidEventArgs>` — Emitted after the list of options is closed.
- **ClosedScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **Closing**: `EventCallback<IgbVoidEventArgs>` — Emitted just before the list of options is closed.
- **ClosingScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **Data**: `IEnumerable<TItem>` — The data source used to generate the list of options. For data that is already JSON, or that the client fetches itself, see .
- **DataJson**: `IJsonData` — The data as or , in place of the component's typed data; set one or the other, not both. Prefer the typed data unless it is already JSON, or the client should fetch it itself.
- **DataScript**: `string` — Provides a means of setting Data in the JavaScript environment.
- **DisableClear**: `bool` — Hides the clear button.
- **DisableFiltering**: `bool` — Disables the filtering of the list of options.
- **Disabled**: `bool` — The disabled state of the component.
- **DisplayKey**: `string` — The key in the data source used to display items in the list.
- **FilteringOptions**: `IgbFilteringOptions` — An object that configures the filtering of the combo.
- **Focus**: `EventCallback<IgbVoidEventArgs>` — Emitted when the component gains focus.
- **FocusScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **GroupHeaderTemplate**: `RenderFragment<IgbComboGroupHeaderContext>` — The template used for the content of each combo group header.
- **GroupHeaderTemplateScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that renders the template used for the content of each combo group header.
- **GroupKey**: `string` — The key in the data source used to group items in the list.
- **GroupSorting**: `GroupingDirection` — Sorts the items in each group by ascending or descending order.
- **Invalid**: `bool` — Sets the control into invalid state (visual state only).
- **ItemTemplate**: `RenderFragment<TItem>` — The template used for the content of each combo item.
- **ItemTemplateScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that renders the template used for the content of each combo item.
- **Label**: `string` — The label of the control.
- **Locale**: `string` — Gets/Sets the locale used for getting language, affecting resource strings.
- **Name**: `string` — The name of the control, under which its value is submitted with its form. Forms posted to the server, as in static server rendering, bind fields by this name.
- **Opened**: `EventCallback<IgbVoidEventArgs>` — Emitted after the list of options is opened.
- **OpenedScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **Opening**: `EventCallback<IgbVoidEventArgs>` — Emitted just before the list of options is opened.
- **OpeningScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **Outlined**: `bool` — Whether the control has an outlined appearance.
- **Placeholder**: `string` — The placeholder text of the control.
- **PlaceholderSearch**: `string` — The placeholder text of the search input.
- **Required**: `bool` — Makes the control a required field in a form context.
- **SingleSelect**: `bool` — Enables single selection mode and moves item filtering to the main input.
- **Value**: `TValue[]` — The value of the control, that is the currently selected items. If the data source is an array of complex objects, must be set. Note that when is not explicitly set, it falls back to the value of .
- **ValueChanged**: `EventCallback<TValue[]>` — Emitted when the Value property changes. Enables two-way binding through .
- **ValueKey**: `string` — The key in the data source used when selecting items.
- **BlurComponent**(): void — Removes focus from the component.
- **BlurComponentAsync**(): Task — Removes focus from the component.
- **CheckValidity**(): bool — Checks for validity of the control and emits the invalid event if it's invalid.
- **CheckValidityAsync**(): Task<bool> — Checks for validity of the control and emits the invalid event if it's invalid.
- **Deselect**(items: TValue[]): void — Deselects one or more options in the list by either reference or . If no items are provided all items are deselected.
- **DeselectAsync**(items: TValue[]): Task — Deselects one or more options in the list by either reference or . If no items are provided all items are deselected.
- **EnsureModulesLoaded**(): void — Requests the client modules this component needs; override to register more through .
- **FocusComponent**(options: IgbFocusOptions): void — Sets focus on the component.
- **FocusComponentAsync**(options: IgbFocusOptions): Task — Sets focus on the component.
- **GetCurrentValue**(): TValue[] — Returns the current value of the combo.
- **GetCurrentValueAsync**(): Task<TValue[]> — Returns the current value of the combo.
- **GetSelection**(): TItem[] — Returns the current selection of the combo.
- **GetSelectionAsync**(): Task<TItem[]> — Returns the current selection of the combo.
- **NotifyClearItems**(dataSource: object): void — Reports that dataSource was emptied.
- **NotifyInsertItem**(dataSource: object, index: int, refItem: object): void — Reports that refItem was inserted into dataSource at index.
- **NotifyRemoveItem**(dataSource: object, index: int, oldItem: object): void — Reports that oldItem was removed from dataSource at index.
- **NotifySetItem**(dataSource: object, index: int, oldItem: object, newItem: object): void — Reports that the item at index in dataSource was replaced by newItem.
- **NotifyUpdateItem**(dataSource: object, index: int, refItem: object, syncDataOnly: bool): void — Reports that properties of refItem, at index in dataSource, changed. With syncDataOnly only the component's copy of the item is refreshed and the component does not re-render.
- **ReportValidity**(): bool — Checks for validity of the control and shows the browser message if it's invalid.
- **ReportValidityAsync**(): Task<bool> — Checks for validity of the control and shows the browser message if it's invalid.
- **ResumeNotifications**(dataSource: object, notify: bool): void — Resumes reporting changes to dataSource. With notify the component reloads the collection's current contents.
- **Select**(items: TValue[]): void — Selects one or more options in the list by either reference or . If no items are provided all items are selected.
- **SelectAsync**(items: TValue[]): Task — Selects one or more options in the list by either reference or . If no items are provided all items are selected.
- **SetCustomValidity**(message: string): void — Sets a custom validation message for the control. As long as message is not empty, the control is considered invalid.
- **SetCustomValidityAsync**(message: string): Task — Sets a custom validation message for the control. As long as message is not empty, the control is considered invalid.
- **SuspendNotifications**(dataSource: object): void — Stops reporting changes to dataSource until , so many changes can be applied as one update.

### [IgbDialog](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbDialog)
A modal dialog component built on the native <dialog> element. The dialog traps focus while open and blocks interaction with the rest of the page (modal semantics). It supports animated open/close transitions, an optional backdrop overlay, and multiple content areas through named slots. The component integrates with the Invoker Commands API: an or a native <button> with command="--show" / "--hide" / "--toggle" and commandfor pointing to this element will call the corresponding method declaratively.

- **constructor**(): void
- **CloseOnOutsideClick**: `bool` — When set, clicking on the backdrop area outside the dialog surface will close it (emitting close events). Has no effect when the dialog is not yet open.
- **Closed**: `EventCallback<IgbVoidEventArgs>` — Emitted after the dialog has fully closed and its exit animation has completed.
- **ClosedScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **Closing**: `EventCallback<IgbVoidEventArgs>` — Emitted just before the dialog closes.
- **ClosingScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **HideDefaultAction**: `bool` — When set, the built-in "OK" close button in the footer is not rendered. Has no effect when content is projected into the footer slot, since the slot content replaces the default button entirely.
- **KeepOpenOnEscape**: `bool` — When set, pressing the Escape key will not close the dialog. By default the browser closes a modal dialog on Escape. Enable this option when the dialog guards unsaved work and should require an explicit user action to dismiss.
- **Open**: `bool` — Whether the dialog is open. Setting this property programmatically will open or close the dialog without animation and without emitting close events. Prefer the , , and methods for animated transitions.
- **ReturnValue**: `string` — The return value of the dialog. Automatically set to the value of the submitter element when a <form method="dialog"> inside the dialog is submitted. Can also be set programmatically before calling .
- **Title**: `string` — The title displayed in the dialog header. Overridden by any content projected into the title slot.
- **EnsureModulesLoaded**(): void — Requests the client modules this component needs; override to register more through .
- **Hide**(): bool — Closes the dialog with an animated fade-out transition.
- **HideAsync**(): Task<bool> — Closes the dialog with an animated fade-out transition.
- **Show**(): bool — Opens the dialog with an animated fade-in transition.
- **ShowAsync**(): Task<bool> — Opens the dialog with an animated fade-in transition.
- **Toggle**(): bool — Toggles the dialog open or closed depending on its current state. Equivalent to calling when closed and when open.
- **ToggleAsync**(): Task<bool> — Toggles the dialog open or closed depending on its current state. Equivalent to calling when closed and when open.

### [IgbHighlight](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbHighlight)
The highlight component provides efficient searching and highlighting of text projected into it via its default slot. It uses the native CSS Custom Highlight API to apply highlight styles to matched text nodes without modifying the DOM. The component supports case-sensitive matching, programmatic navigation between matches, and automatic scroll-into-view of the active match.

- **constructor**(): void
- **CaseSensitive**: `bool` — Whether to match the searched text with case sensitivity in mind. When true, only exact-case occurrences of are highlighted.
- **SearchText**: `string` — The string to search and highlight in the DOM content of the component. Setting this property triggers a new search automatically. An empty string clears all highlights.
- **EnsureModulesLoaded**(): void — Requests the client modules this component needs; override to register more through .
- **GetCurrent**(): double — Get the zero-based index of the currently active (focused) match.
- **GetCurrentAsync**(): Task<double> — Get the zero-based index of the currently active (focused) match.
- **GetSize**(): double — Get the total number of matches found for the current .
- **GetSizeAsync**(): Task<double> — Get the total number of matches found for the current .
- **Next**(options: IgbHighlightNavigation): void — Moves the active highlight to the next match. Wraps around to the first match after the last one.
- **NextAsync**(options: IgbHighlightNavigation): Task — Moves the active highlight to the next match. Wraps around to the first match after the last one.
- **Previous**(options: IgbHighlightNavigation): void — Moves the active highlight to the previous match. Wraps around to the last match when going back from the first one.
- **PreviousAsync**(options: IgbHighlightNavigation): Task — Moves the active highlight to the previous match. Wraps around to the last match when going back from the first one.
- **Search**(): void — Re-runs the highlight search based on the current and values. Call this method after the projected content changes dynamically (e.g. after lazy loading or programmatic DOM mutations) to ensure all matches are up to date.
- **SearchAsync**(): Task — Re-runs the highlight search based on the current and values. Call this method after the projected content changes dynamically (e.g. after lazy loading or programmatic DOM mutations) to ensure all matches are up to date.
- **SetActive**(index: double, options: IgbHighlightNavigation): void — Moves the active highlight to the match at the specified zero-based index.
- **SetActiveAsync**(index: double, options: IgbHighlightNavigation): Task — Moves the active highlight to the match at the specified zero-based index.

### [IgbHighlightModule](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbHighlightModule)

### [IgbHighlightNavigation](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbHighlightNavigation)

- **ValueMode**: `MaskInputValueMode` — Dictates the behavior when retrieving the value of the control. returns the clean input, for example 5551234567. returns the value with the mask formatting applied, for example (555) 123-4567. Empty values always return an empty string, regardless of the value mode.

### [IgbModuleAttribute<TModule>](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbModuleAttribute<TModule>)
Marks a module class so the trimmer preserves its public methods whenever the type is kept, keeping the reflective Register lookup working under trimming; unreferenced modules still trim away. Applied self-referentially, e.g. [IgbModule<IgbTreeModule>]. A plain class-level would not work here: it only activates for instantiated types (or annotated GetType() flows), and module classes are only ever referenced via typeof.

### [IgbNavDrawer](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbNavDrawer)
A side navigation container that provides quick access between views within an application. For non-relative positions (, , , ) the drawer is rendered as a native <dialog> element, providing modal semantics, automatic focus trapping, and a backdrop. For the position it is rendered inline as a <nav> landmark. When content is provided in the mini slot, a compact icon-only variant is always displayed alongside the main drawer (hidden only while the full drawer is open). The component integrates with the Invoker Commands API: an Ignite UI button or a native <button> with command="--show" / "--hide" / "--toggle" and commandfor pointing to this component will call the corresponding method declaratively.

- **constructor**(): void
- **Closed**: `EventCallback<IgbVoidEventArgs>` — Emitted just after the drawer is closed by a user interaction.
- **ClosedScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **Closing**: `EventCallback<IgbVoidEventArgs>` — Emitted just before the drawer is closed by a user interaction.
- **ClosingScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **KeepOpenOnEscape**: `bool` — Determines whether the drawer should remain open when the Escape key is pressed. This is only applicable when the drawer is in a non-relative position, as the Escape key does not trigger the closing of relative drawers.
- **Label**: `string` — Sets an accessible label for the drawer. In non-relative positions this label is applied to the modal <dialog> element. In position it labels the <nav> landmark. When multiple navigation landmarks exist on the page each should receive a distinct label so screen-reader users can differentiate between them.
- **Open**: `bool` — Whether the drawer is open.
- **Position**: `NavDrawerPosition` — Sets the position of the drawer. — anchored to the inline-start edge (default). — anchored to the inline-end edge. — anchored to the block-start edge. — anchored to the block-end edge. — rendered inline within the page flow; no modal backdrop.
- **EnsureModulesLoaded**(): void — Requests the client modules this component needs; override to register more through .
- **Hide**(): bool — Closes the drawer.
- **HideAsync**(): Task<bool> — Closes the drawer.
- **Show**(): bool — Opens the drawer.
- **ShowAsync**(): Task<bool> — Opens the drawer.
- **Toggle**(): bool — Toggles the open state of the drawer. Delegates to or depending on the current state.
- **ToggleAsync**(): Task<bool> — Toggles the open state of the drawer. Delegates to or depending on the current state.

### [IgbNumberFormatOptions](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbNumberFormatOptions)
The options used to format numbers, mirroring the browser Intl.NumberFormatOptions. Currently used for the thumb and tick label values of and .

- **constructor**(): void
- **CompactDisplay**: `string` — The form of the compact notation, either short or long. Applies only when is compact.
- **Currency**: `string` — The currency used in currency formatting, given as an ISO 4217 currency code.
- **CurrencyDisplay**: `string` — How the currency is shown, one of symbol, narrowSymbol, code or name.
- **CurrencySign**: `string` — How negative currency amounts are rendered, either standard or accounting.
- **LocaleMatcher**: `string` — The locale matching algorithm, either lookup or best fit.
- **MaximumFractionDigits**: `int?` — The maximum number of fraction digits to use.
- **MaximumSignificantDigits**: `int?` — The maximum number of significant digits to use.
- **MinimumFractionDigits**: `int?` — The minimum number of fraction digits to use.
- **MinimumIntegerDigits**: `int?` — The minimum number of integer digits to use.
- **MinimumSignificantDigits**: `int?` — The minimum number of significant digits to use.
- **Notation**: `string` — The formatting notation, one of standard, scientific, engineering or compact.
- **NumberingSystem**: `string` — The numbering system used to render the digits.
- **SignDisplay**: `string` — When the sign is shown, one of auto, never, always or exceptZero.
- **Style**: `string` — The formatting style, one of decimal, currency, percent or unit.
- **Unit**: `string` — The unit used when is unit.
- **UnitDisplay**: `string` — How the unit is shown, one of short, narrow or long.
- **UseGrouping**: `NumberFormatGrouping` — When grouping separators, such as thousands separators, are used.

### [IgbQrCode](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbQrCode)
Generates a QR code based on the provided value and options. The component renders an SVG representation of the QR code, which can be customized using various properties.

- **constructor**(): void
- **DotStyle**: `QrDotStyle` — The style of the data modules (dots) in the QR code, and of the inner dot of each finder-pattern corner.
- **ErrorLevel**: `QrErrorCorrectionLevel?` — The error correction level for the QR code, which determines the QR code's ability to be read if it is partially obscured or damaged. provides the lowest level of error correction and provides the highest level. When null, the web component's default level applies.
- **LogoMargin**: `double?` — The margin around the logo in pixels. This is the whitespace area surrounding the logo within the QR code, which helps ensure that the logo does not interfere with the QR code's scannability.
- **LogoSize**: `double` — The size of the logo, as a ratio of the maximum area that can safely be obscured by a logo while the QR code remains scannable. The value should be a number between 0 and 1, where 0 means no logo and 1 means the logo will cover the full safe area (not the entire QR code). When is not explicitly set, the smallest error correction level that can accommodate the requested logo size is chosen automatically.
- **LogoSrc**: `string` — The source URL of an optional logo image to be displayed at the center of the QR code. If provided, the component will attempt to render the logo within the QR code while maintaining scannability.
- **Margin**: `double` — The margin (quiet zone) around the QR code, expressed as a number of QR code modules rather than pixels. This is the blank border area surrounding the code, which helps ensure that it can be properly scanned.
- **Size**: `double` — The size of the QR code in pixels. This determines the width and height of the generated QR code. The default value is 128 pixels.
- **SquareStyle**: `QrCornerSquareStyle` — The style of the corner squares in the QR code.
- **Value**: `string` — The value to be encoded in the QR code. This can be any string, such as a URL, text, or other data. When this property is set, the component will generate a QR code representing the provided value.
- **Version**: `double?` — The version of the QR code to generate, which determines the size and data capacity of the QR code. Valid values are integers from 1 to 40, where each version corresponds to a specific module size and data capacity. If not specified, the component will automatically select the smallest version that can accommodate the provided value.
- **EnsureModulesLoaded**(): void — Requests the client modules this component needs; override to register more through .
- **ToImage**(options: IgbQrCodeExportOptions): void — Exports the QR code as an image file in the browser. The option multiplies the of the component: a 256px QR code exported with a scale of 2 produces a 512x512 image.
- **ToImageAsync**(options: IgbQrCodeExportOptions): Task — Exports the QR code as an image file in the browser. The option multiplies the of the component: a 256px QR code exported with a scale of 2 produces a 512x512 image.

### [IgbQrCodeExportOptions](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbQrCodeExportOptions)
Options controlling how a QR code is exported to an image file, passed to the ToImage methods of .

- **constructor**(): void
- **FileName**: `string` — The name of the exported file. The extension of the format is appended when the name does not end with it. Defaults to qr-code.
- **Format**: `QrCodeExportFormat` — The output format.
- **Scale**: `double` — Multiplier applied to the of the component. A 256px QR code with a scale of 2 exports as a 512x512 image. For , the multiplier applies to the width and height attributes while the viewBox is unchanged.

### [IgbQrCodeModule](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbQrCodeModule)
Client resource module for .

### [IgbRating<TValue>](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbRating<TValue>)
A rating component that allows users to view and provide ratings using customizable symbols. It supports fractional values, hover previews, keyboard navigation, single-selection mode, and integrates with forms as a number input.

- **constructor**(): void
- **AllowReset**: `bool` — Whether to reset the rating when the user selects the same value.
- **Change**: `EventCallback<IgbNumberEventArgs<TValue>>` — Emitted when the value of the control changes.
- **ChangeScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **Disabled**: `bool` — The disabled state of the component.
- **Hover**: `EventCallback<IgbNumberEventArgs<TValue>>` — Emitted when hover is enabled and the user mouses over a symbol of the rating.
- **HoverPreview**: `bool` — Sets hover preview behavior for the component.
- **HoverScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **Invalid**: `bool` — Sets the control into invalid state (visual state only).
- **Label**: `string` — The label of the control.
- **Max**: `double` — The maximum value for the rating. If there are projected symbols, the maximum value will be resolved based on the number of symbols.
- **Name**: `string` — The name of the control, under which its value is submitted with its form. Forms posted to the server, as in static server rendering, bind fields by this name.
- **ReadOnly**: `bool` — Makes the control a readonly field.
- **Single**: `bool` — Toggles single selection visual mode.
- **Step**: `double` — The minimum value change allowed. Valid values are in the interval between 0 and 1 inclusive.
- **Value**: `TValue` — The value of the component.
- **ValueChanged**: `EventCallback<TValue>` — Emitted when the Value property changes. Enables two-way binding through .
- **ValueFormat**: `string` — A format string which sets aria-valuetext. Instances of {0} will be replaced with the current value of the control and instances of {1} with the maximum value for the control. Important for screen-readers and useful for localization.
- **CheckValidity**(): bool — Checks for validity of the control and emits the invalid event if it's invalid.
- **CheckValidityAsync**(): Task<bool> — Checks for validity of the control and emits the invalid event if it's invalid.
- **EnsureModulesLoaded**(): void — Requests the client modules this component needs; override to register more through .
- **GetCurrentValue**(): TValue — Return the current value of the component.
- **GetCurrentValueAsync**(): Task<TValue> — Return the current value of the component.
- **ReportValidity**(): bool — Checks for validity of the control and shows the browser message if it's invalid.
- **ReportValidityAsync**(): Task<bool> — Checks for validity of the control and shows the browser message if it's invalid.
- **SetCustomValidity**(message: string): void — Sets a custom validation message for the control. As long as message is not empty, the control is considered invalid.
- **SetCustomValidityAsync**(message: string): Task — Sets a custom validation message for the control. As long as message is not empty, the control is considered invalid.
- **StepDown**(n: double): void — Decrements the value of the control by n steps multiplied by the step factor.
- **StepDownAsync**(n: double): Task — Decrements the value of the control by n steps multiplied by the step factor.
- **StepUp**(n: double): void — Increments the value of the control by n steps multiplied by the step factor.
- **StepUpAsync**(n: double): Task — Increments the value of the control by n steps multiplied by the step factor.

### [IgbSliderBase](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbSliderBase)
Base class shared by and .

- **constructor**(): void
- **Disabled**: `bool` — Disables the UI interactions of the slider.
- **DiscreteTrack**: `bool` — Marks the slider track as discrete so it displays the steps. If is 0, the slider remains continuous even if is true.
- **HidePrimaryLabels**: `bool` — Hides the primary tick labels.
- **HideSecondaryLabels**: `bool` — Hides the secondary tick labels.
- **HideTooltip**: `bool` — Hides the thumb tooltip.
- **Locale**: `string` — The locale used to format the thumb and tick label values in the slider.
- **LowerBound**: `double?` — The lower bound of the slider value. If not set, the value is applied.
- **Max**: `double` — The maximum value of the slider scale. Defaults to 100. If is less than the assignment is a no-op. If children are provided, then is always set to the number of labels. If ends up being greater than the current value, it is automatically assigned the new value.
- **Min**: `double` — The minimum value of the slider scale. Defaults to 0. If is greater than the assignment is a no-op. If children are provided, then is always set to 0. If ends up being less than the current value, it is automatically assigned the new value.
- **PrimaryTicks**: `double` — The number of primary ticks. It defaults to 0 which means no primary ticks are displayed.
- **SecondaryTicks**: `double` — The number of secondary ticks. It defaults to 0 which means no secondary ticks are displayed.
- **Step**: `double` — Specifies the granularity that the value must adhere to. If set to 0 no stepping is implied and any value in the range is allowed. If children are provided then the step is always assumed to be 1, since it is a discrete slider.
- **TickLabelRotation**: `SliderTickLabelRotation` — The degrees for the rotation of the tick labels. Defaults to 0.
- **TickOrientation**: `SliderTickOrientation` — Changes the orientation of the ticks.
- **UpperBound**: `double?` — The upper bound of the slider value. If not set, the value is applied.
- **ValueFormat**: `string` — String format used for the thumb and tick label values in the slider.
- **ValueFormatOptions**: `IgbNumberFormatOptions` — Number format options used for the thumb and tick label values in the slider.

### [IgbSnackbar](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbSnackbar)
A snackbar component is used to provide feedback about an operation by showing a brief message at the bottom of the screen. The component integrates with the Invoker Commands API: an Ignite UI button or a native <button> with command="--show" / "--hide" / "--toggle" and commandfor pointing to this component will call the corresponding method declaratively.

- **constructor**(): void
- **Action**: `EventCallback<IgbVoidEventArgs>` — Emitted when the snackbar action button is clicked.
- **ActionScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **ActionText**: `string` — The text of the action button.
- **EnsureModulesLoaded**(): void — Requests the client modules this component needs; override to register more through .

- **Register**(runtime: IIgniteUIBlazor): void — Requests this module's client resources to be loaded into the runtime.

### [IgbSplitter](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbSplitter)
A splitter component that provides a resizable split-pane layout, dividing the view into two panels — start and end — separated by a draggable bar. Panels can be resized by dragging the bar, using keyboard shortcuts, or collapsed/expanded using the built-in collapse buttons or the method. Nested splitters are supported for more complex layouts.

- **constructor**(): void
- **DisableCollapse**: `bool` — When true, prevents the user from collapsing either pane. This also hides the expand/collapse buttons on the splitter bar.
- **DisableResize**: `bool` — When true, prevents the user from resizing the panes by dragging the splitter bar or using keyboard shortcuts. This also hides the drag handle on the splitter bar.
- **EndCollapsed**: `bool` — Whether the end pane is currently collapsed. Set this property to collapse or expand the pane programmatically.
- **EndMaxSize**: `string` — The maximum size of the end pane.
- **EndMinSize**: `string` — The minimum size of the end pane.
- **EndSize**: `string` — The size of the end pane.
- **HideCollapseButtons**: `bool` — When true, hides the expand/collapse buttons on the splitter bar. Note that the buttons will also be hidden if is true or if a pane is currently collapsed.
- **HideDragHandle**: `bool` — When true, hides the drag handle on the splitter bar. Note that the drag handle will also be hidden if is true.
- **LayoutChanged**: `EventCallback<IgbSplitterLayoutChangedEventArgs>` — Emitted after a user-driven resize or expansion change, with a full snapshot of the current layout (pane sizes and collapsed states).
- **LayoutChangedScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **Orientation**: `SplitterOrientation` — The orientation of the splitter, which determines the direction of resizing and collapsing.
- **ResizeEnd**: `EventCallback<IgbSplitterResizeEventArgs>` — Emitted once when a resize operation completes.
- **ResizeEndScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **ResizeStart**: `EventCallback<IgbSplitterResizeEventArgs>` — Emitted once when a resize operation begins (pointer drag or keyboard).
- **ResizeStartScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **Resizing**: `EventCallback<IgbSplitterResizeEventArgs>` — Emitted continuously while a pane is being resized.
- **ResizingScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **StartCollapsed**: `bool` — Whether the start pane is currently collapsed. Set this property to collapse or expand the pane programmatically.
- **StartMaxSize**: `string` — The maximum size of the start pane.
- **StartMinSize**: `string` — The minimum size of the start pane.
- **StartSize**: `string` — The size of the start pane.
- **EnsureModulesLoaded**(): void — Requests the client modules this component needs; override to register more through .
- **Toggle**(position: PanePosition): void — Toggles the collapsed state of the specified pane.
- **ToggleAsync**(position: PanePosition): Task — Toggles the collapsed state of the specified pane.

### [IgbSplitterLayoutChangedEventArgs](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbSplitterLayoutChangedEventArgs)

- **Detail**: `IgbSplitterLayoutChangedEventArgsDetail` — A full snapshot of the current layout (pane sizes and collapsed states).

The payload of the event: a full snapshot of the current layout (pane sizes and collapsed states).

- **constructor**(): void
- **EndCollapsed**: `bool` — Whether the end pane is currently collapsed.
- **EndSize**: `string` — The current size of the end pane.
- **StartCollapsed**: `bool` — Whether the start pane is currently collapsed.
- **StartSize**: `string` — The current size of the start pane.

The payload of the , and events.

- **constructor**(): void
- **Delta**: `double` — The change in size since the resize operation started. Only set for and .

### [IgbStep](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbStep)
A step component used within an to represent an individual step in a wizard-like workflow.

- **constructor**(): void
- **Active**: `bool` — Whether the step is active. Active steps are styled with an active state and their content is visible.
- **Complete**: `bool` — Whether the step is completed.
- **Disabled**: `bool` — Whether the step is disabled. Disabled steps are styled with a disabled state and are not interactive.
- **Invalid**: `bool` — Whether the step is invalid. Invalid steps are styled with an error state and are not interactive when the stepper is in linear mode.
- **Optional**: `bool` — Whether the step is optional. Optional steps validity does not affect the default behavior when the stepper is in linear mode i.e. if optional step is invalid the user could still move to the next step.
- **EnsureModulesLoaded**(): void — Requests the client modules this component needs; override to register more through .

### [IgbStepper](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbStepper)
A stepper component that provides a wizard-like workflow by dividing content into logical steps.

- **constructor**(): void
- **ActiveStepChanged**: `EventCallback<IgbActiveStepChangedEventArgs>` — Emitted after the active step has changed.
- **ActiveStepChangedScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **ActiveStepChanging**: `EventCallback<IgbActiveStepChangingEventArgs>` — Emitted when the active step is about to change.
- **ActiveStepChangingScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **AnimationDuration**: `double` — The animation duration in either vertical or horizontal mode in milliseconds.
- **ContentTop**: `bool` — Whether the content is displayed above the steps.
- **HorizontalAnimation**: `HorizontalTransitionAnimation` — The animation type when in horizontal mode.
- **Linear**: `bool` — Whether the stepper is linear.
- **Orientation**: `StepperOrientation` — The orientation of the stepper.
- **StepType**: `StepperStepType` — The visual type of the steps.
- **TitlePosition**: `StepperTitlePosition` — The position of the steps title.
- **VerticalAnimation**: `StepperVerticalAnimation` — The animation type when in vertical mode.
- **EnsureModulesLoaded**(): void — Requests the client modules this component needs; override to register more through .
- **GetSteps**(): IgbStep[] — Returns all of the stepper's steps.
- **GetStepsAsync**(): Task<IgbStep[]> — Returns all of the stepper's steps.
- **NavigateTo**(index: double): void — Activates the step at a given index.
- **NavigateToAsync**(index: double): Task — Activates the step at a given index.
- **Next**(): void — Activates the next enabled step.
- **NextAsync**(): Task — Activates the next enabled step.
- **Prev**(): void — Activates the previous enabled step.
- **PrevAsync**(): Task — Activates the previous enabled step.
- **Reset**(): void — Resets the stepper to its initial state, i.e. activates the first step.
- **ResetAsync**(): Task — Resets the stepper to its initial state, i.e. activates the first step.

### [IgbTabs](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbTabs)
Tabs organize and allow navigation between groups of content that are related and at the same level of hierarchy. The component allows the user to navigate between multiple children. It supports keyboard navigation and provides API methods to control the selected tab.

- **constructor**(): void
- **Activation**: `TabsActivation` — Determines the tab activation. When set to , the tab is instantly selected while navigating with the Left/Right Arrows, Home or End keys and the corresponding panel is displayed. When set to , the tab is only focused. The selection happens after pressing Space or Enter.
- **Alignment**: `TabsAlignment` — Sets the alignment for the tab headers.
- **Change**: `EventCallback<IgbTabComponentEventArgs>` — Emitted when the selected tab changes.
- **ChangeScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **EnsureModulesLoaded**(): void — Requests the client modules this component needs; override to register more through .
- **GetSelected**(): string — Gets the currently selected tab.
- **GetSelectedAsync**(): Task<string> — Gets the currently selected tab.
- **GetSelectedTab**(): IgbTab — Returns the currently selected tab, or null when no tab is selected.
- **GetSelectedTabAsync**(): Task<IgbTab> — Returns the currently selected tab, or null when no tab is selected.
- **Select**(id: string): void — Selects the specified tab and displays the corresponding panel.
- **SelectAsync**(id: string): Task — Selects the specified tab and displays the corresponding panel.

### [IgbTextarea](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbTextarea)
Represents a multi-line plain-text editing control, useful when you want to allow users to enter a sizeable amount of free-form text, for example a comment on a review or feedback form.

- **constructor**(): void
- **Autocapitalize**: `string` — Controls whether and how text input is automatically capitalized as it is entered/edited by the user. MDN documentation.
- **Autocomplete**: `string` — Specifies what permission, if any, the browser has to provide automated assistance in filling out form field values, as well as guidance to the browser as to the type of information expected in the field. Refer to this page for additional information.
- **Blur**: `EventCallback<IgbVoidEventArgs>` — Emitted when the component loses focus.
- **BlurScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **Change**: `EventCallback<IgbComponentValueChangedEventArgs>` — Emitted when a change to the control value is committed by the user.
- **ChangeScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **Disabled**: `bool` — The disabled state of the component.
- **Focus**: `EventCallback<IgbVoidEventArgs>` — Emitted when the component gains focus.
- **FocusScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **Input**: `EventCallback<IgbComponentValueChangedEventArgs>` — Emitted when the control receives user input.
- **InputMode**: `string` — Hints at the type of data that might be entered by the user while editing the control or its contents. This allows a browser to display an appropriate virtual keyboard. MDN documentation.
- **InputScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **Invalid**: `bool` — Sets the control into invalid state (visual state only).
- **Label**: `string` — The label for the control.
- **MaxLength**: `double?` — The maximum number of characters (UTF-16 code units) that the user can enter. If this value isn't specified, the user can enter an unlimited number of characters.
- **MinLength**: `double?` — The minimum number of characters (UTF-16 code units) that the user is required to enter.
- **Name**: `string` — The name of the control, under which its value is submitted with its form. Forms posted to the server, as in static server rendering, bind fields by this name.
- **Outlined**: `bool` — Whether the control will have outlined appearance.
- **Placeholder**: `string` — The placeholder text of the control.
- **ReadOnly**: `bool` — Makes the control a readonly field.
- **Required**: `bool` — Makes the control a required field in a form context.
- **Resize**: `TextareaResize` — Controls whether the control can be resized. When is set, the control will try to expand and fit its content.
- **Rows**: `double` — The number of visible text lines for the control. If it is specified, it must be a positive integer. If it is not specified, the default value is 3.
- **Spellcheck**: `bool` — Controls whether the control may be checked for spelling errors.
- **ValidateOnly**: `bool` — Enables validation rules to be evaluated without restricting user input. This applies to the property when it is defined.
- **Value**: `string` — The value of the component.
- **ValueChanged**: `EventCallback<string>` — Emitted when the Value property changes. Enables two-way binding through .
- **Wrap**: `TextareaWrap` — Indicates how the control should wrap the value for form submission. Refer to this page on MDN for explanation of the available values.
- **CheckValidity**(): bool — Checks for validity of the control and emits the invalid event if it is invalid.
- **CheckValidityAsync**(): Task<bool> — Checks for validity of the control and emits the invalid event if it is invalid.
- **EnsureModulesLoaded**(): void — Requests the client modules this component needs; override to register more through .
- **GetCurrentValue**(): string — Returns the current value of the component.
- **GetCurrentValueAsync**(): Task<string> — Returns the current value of the component.
- **ReportValidity**(): bool — Checks for validity of the control and shows the browser message if it's invalid.
- **ReportValidityAsync**(): Task<bool> — Checks for validity of the control and shows the browser message if it's invalid.
- **Select**(): void — Selects all text within the control.
- **SelectAsync**(): Task — Selects all text within the control.
- **SetCustomValidity**(message: string): void — Sets a custom validation message for the control. As long as message is not empty, the control is considered invalid.
- **SetCustomValidityAsync**(message: string): Task — Sets a custom validation message for the control. As long as message is not empty, the control is considered invalid.

### [IgbTextareaModule](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbTextareaModule)

- **constructor**(): void
- **Register**(runtime: IIgniteUIBlazor): void — Requests this module's client resources to be loaded into the runtime.

### [IgbToast](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbToast)
A toast component is used to show a brief, non-interactive notification.

### [IgbTooltip](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbTooltip)
Provides a way to display supplementary information related to an element when a user interacts with it, for example on hover or focus. It offers features such as placement customization, delays, sticky mode, and animations.

- **constructor**(): void
- **Anchor**: `string` — The ID of the element to use as the anchor for the tooltip.
- **Closed**: `EventCallback<IgbVoidEventArgs>` — Emitted after the tooltip has been fully removed from view.
- **ClosedScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **Closing**: `EventCallback<IgbVoidEventArgs>` — Emitted before the tooltip begins to close.
- **ClosingScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **HideDelay**: `double` — Specifies the number of milliseconds that should pass before hiding the tooltip.
- **HideTriggers**: `string` — Which event triggers will hide the tooltip. Expects a comma separated string of different event triggers.
- **Message**: `string` — Specifies plain text as the tooltip content.
- **Offset**: `double` — The offset of the tooltip from the anchor in pixels.
- **Open**: `bool` — Whether the tooltip is showing.
- **Opened**: `EventCallback<IgbVoidEventArgs>` — Emitted after the tooltip has successfully opened and is visible.
- **OpenedScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **Opening**: `EventCallback<IgbVoidEventArgs>` — Emitted before the tooltip begins to open.
- **OpeningScript**: `string` — Name of a client-side function that handles the event in the browser instead.
- **Placement**: `PopoverPlacement` — Where to place the tooltip relative to its anchor element.
- **ScrollStrategy**: `PopoverScrollStrategy` — Sets the behavior of the tooltip when a parent container scrolls. With , a tooltip also closes.
- **ShowDelay**: `double` — Specifies the number of milliseconds that should pass before showing the tooltip.
- **ShowTriggers**: `string` — Which event triggers will show the tooltip. Expects a comma separated string of different event triggers.
- **Sticky**: `bool` — Specifies if the tooltip remains visible until the user closes it via the close button or Esc key.
- **WithArrow**: `bool` — Whether to render an arrow indicator for the tooltip.
- **EnsureModulesLoaded**(): void — Requests the client modules this component needs; override to register more through .
- **Hide**(): bool — Hides the tooltip if not already hidden.
- **HideAsync**(): Task<bool> — Hides the tooltip if not already hidden.
- **Show**(target: string): bool — Shows the tooltip if not already showing. If target is provided, it is set as a transient anchor.
- **ShowAsync**(target: string): Task<bool> — Shows the tooltip if not already showing. If target is provided, it is set as a transient anchor.
- **Toggle**(): bool — Toggles the tooltip between shown and hidden state.
- **ToggleAsync**(): Task<bool> — Toggles the tooltip between shown and hidden state.

### [IgbTree](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgbTree)

### [IgniteUIBlazorSettings](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/IgniteUIBlazorSettings)

- **ModulesToLoad**: `ReadOnlyCollection<Type>` — Modules whose client resources load at startup.

- **WithJsonSerializerOptions**(options: IgniteUIJsonSerializerOptions): IgniteUIBlazorSettings — Returns a copy using options.
- **WithModulesToLoad**(modulesToLoad: ReadOnlyCollection<Type>): IgniteUIBlazorSettings — Returns a copy that loads modulesToLoad at startup.

### [InfragisticsBlazorExtensions](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/InfragisticsBlazorExtensions)
