### [LocalJson](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/LocalJson)
An escape hatch for data that is already JSON text, set through in place of a component's typed data. The text reaches the client as it is, with no deserialization on the .NET side, so the items never exist as .NET objects: those the component hands back, such as in its events or selection, arrive as values. Change notifications do not apply; assign a new instance to update.

- **constructor**(json: string): void
- **Json**: `string` — The JSON text.
- **From**(json: string): LocalJson — Creates a value from json.

### [RemoteJson](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/RemoteJson)
An escape hatch for data the client fetches itself as JSON from a URL, set through in place of a component's typed data. The data never passes through the .NET side, so the URL must be reachable from the browser, and the items never exist as .NET objects: those the component hands back, such as in its events or selection, arrive as values. Change notifications do not apply; assign a new instance to reload.

- **constructor**(uri: string): void
- **Uri**: `string` — The URL the client fetches.
- **From**(uri: string): RemoteJson — Creates a value from uri.

### [WCAttributeNameAttribute](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/WCAttributeNameAttribute)
Names the web component attribute a parameter maps to, when it differs from the parameter name.

- **constructor**(alternateName: string): void
- **Name**: `string` — The web component attribute name.

### [WCEnumNameAttribute](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/WCEnumNameAttribute)
Names the web component value an enum member maps to.

- **constructor**(alternateName: string): void
- **Name**: `string` — The web component value.

### [WCWidgetMemberNameAttribute](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/classes/WCWidgetMemberNameAttribute)
Names the web component property a parameter maps to, when it differs from the parameter name.

- **constructor**(alternateName: string): void
- **Name**: `string` — The web component property name.

## Interfaces

### [IDataSourceNotifications](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/interfaces/IDataSourceNotifications)
Reports changes made to a bound data collection, so the component updates without the collection being reassigned. A collection implementing reports insertions, removals and replacements on its own; use these methods for other collections, and for changes to an item's properties, which no collection reports.

- **NotifyClearItems(object)**: `any` — Reports that dataSource was emptied.
- **NotifyInsertItem(object, int, object)**: `any` — Reports that refItem was inserted into dataSource at index.
- **NotifyRemoveItem(object, int, object)**: `any` — Reports that oldItem was removed from dataSource at index.
- **NotifySetItem(object, int, object, object)**: `any` — Reports that the item at index in dataSource was replaced by newItem.
- **NotifyUpdateItem(object, int, object, bool)**: `any` — Reports that properties of refItem, at index in dataSource, changed. With syncDataOnly only the component's copy of the item is refreshed and the component does not re-render.
- **ResumeNotifications(object, bool)**: `any` — Resumes reporting changes to dataSource. With notify the component reloads the collection's current contents.
- **SuspendNotifications(object)**: `any` — Stops reporting changes to dataSource until , so many changes can be applied as one update.

### [IIgbModule](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/interfaces/IIgbModule)
A client resource module that can register itself with the Ignite UI Blazor runtime. Implemented by the component *Module classes.

- **Register(IIgniteUIBlazor)**: `any` — Requests this module's client resources to be loaded into the runtime.

### [IIgniteUIBlazor](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/interfaces/IIgniteUIBlazor)
The Ignite UI for Blazor runtime service, registered by . Inject it and pass it to a module's method to load that module's client resources.


### [IIgniteUIBlazorSettings](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/interfaces/IIgniteUIBlazorSettings)
The Ignite UI for Blazor runtime settings.

- **ForceJsonDataMarshalling**: `bool` — Sends bound data to the client as JSON even where a faster in-memory transfer is available.
- **JsonSerializerOptions**: `IgniteUIJsonSerializerOptions` — Options for serializing values sent to the client.
- **ModulesToLoad**: `ReadOnlyCollection<Type>` — Modules whose client resources load at startup.

### [IJsonData](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/interfaces/IJsonData)
Data the client receives as JSON that the .NET side never parses: or .


### [IJsonDataBinding](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/interfaces/IJsonDataBinding)
Lets a component take its data as JSON that the .NET side never parses, an escape hatch next to its typed data parameter.

- **DataJson**: `IJsonData` — The data as or , in place of the component's typed data; set one or the other, not both. Prefer the typed data unless it is already JSON, or the client should fetch it itself.

### [AbsolutePosition](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/AbsolutePosition)

- **Middle** — Centered vertically.
- **Top** — Aligned to the top edge.

- **Rounded** — Square with rounded corners.
- **Square** — Square with sharp corners.

Shape of an .

- **Rounded** — Circular or pill shape.
- **Square** — Square shape with rounded corners.

### [ButtonBaseTarget](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/ButtonBaseTarget)
Browsing context in which a link button opens its Href. Mirrors the HTML anchor target attribute.

- **_blank** — A new tab or window.
- **_parent** — The parent browsing context; falls back to if there is none.
- **_self** — The current browsing context.
- **_top** — The top-level browsing context; falls back to if there is none.

### [ButtonBaseType](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/ButtonBaseType)
Form behavior of a button. Mirrors the HTML button type attribute.

- **Button** — No default form behavior.
- **Reset** — Resets the associated form fields to their initial values.
- **Submit** — Submits the associated form.

### [ButtonGroupSelection](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/ButtonGroupSelection)
Selection mode of an .

- **Multiple** — Any number of buttons can be selected.
- **Single** — At most one button is selected. Clicking the selected button deselects it.
- **SingleRequired** — Exactly one button stays selected. Clicking the selected button leaves it selected.

### [ButtonVariant](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/ButtonVariant)
Visual style of an .

- **Contained** — Filled background; highest visual emphasis.
- **Fab** — Floating action button, typically used for a screen's primary action.
- **Flat** — No background or border; lowest visual emphasis.
- **Outlined** — Transparent background with a visible border.

### [CalendarActiveView](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/CalendarActiveView)
The view an is currently showing.

- **Days** — Days of a month.
- **Months** — Months of a year.
- **Years** — A range of years.

### [CalendarHeaderOrientation](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/CalendarHeaderOrientation)

- **Horizontal** — Header above the calendar body.
- **Vertical** — Header beside the calendar body.

### [CalendarSelection](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/CalendarSelection)
Selection mode of a calendar.

- **Multiple** — Any number of individual dates.
- **Range** — A contiguous range between two dates.
- **Single** — A single date.

### [CarouselAnimationDirection](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/CarouselAnimationDirection)
Direction of the slide transition when an selects a slide programmatically.

- **Next** — Animate as if moving forward to a later slide.
- **Prev** — Animate as if moving back to an earlier slide.

### [CarouselIndicatorsOrientation](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/CarouselIndicatorsOrientation)
Placement of the slide indicators (dots) of an .

- **End** — After the slides: below them in a horizontal carousel, at the inline end (right in left-to-right layouts) in a vertical one.
- **Start** — Before the slides: above them in a horizontal carousel, at the inline start (left in left-to-right layouts) in a vertical one.

- **BelowMessages** — Below the message list.

### [ColorFormat](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/ColorFormat)
The notation an renders its string value in.

- **Hex** — Hexadecimal notation, #rrggbb.
- **Hsl** — HSL notation, hsl(h s% l%).
- **Rgb** — RGB notation, rgb(r g b).

### [ColorPickerMode](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/ColorPickerMode)
How an presents the anchor that opens it.

- **Default** — The anchor is a trigger button.
- **Input** — The anchor is an editable text field with a color swatch prefix that also opens the picker.

### [ComboChangeType](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/ComboChangeType)
Kind of change reported by an change event.

- **Addition** — A custom value typed by the user was added as an item.
- **Deselection** — One or more items were deselected.
- **Selection** — One or more items were selected.

### [ContentOrientation](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/ContentOrientation)
Layout direction of a component's content, such as the buttons of a group, the radios of a radio group, or the months of a multi-month calendar.

- **Horizontal** — Items laid out side by side.
- **Vertical** — Items stacked top to bottom.

### [DatePart](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/DatePart)
Segment of a date/time value that a date-time input can step up or down.

- **AmPm** — The AM/PM designator of a 12-hour clock.
- **Date** — The day of the month.
- **Hours** — The hours.
- **Minutes** — The minutes.
- **Month** — The month.
- **Seconds** — The seconds.
- **Year** — The year.

### [DateRangeType](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/DateRangeType)
How an matches dates against its .

- **After** — Dates after the first date in the range.
- **Before** — Dates before the first date in the range.
- **Between** — Dates between the first and last date in the range, inclusive.
- **Specific** — Only the dates listed in the range.
- **Weekdays** — Monday through Friday. The range is ignored.
- **Weekends** — Saturday and Sunday. The range is ignored.

### [DividerType](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/DividerType)
Line style of an .

- **Dashed** — A dashed line.
- **Solid** — A continuous line.

- **End** — After the header content.
- **None** — No indicator is rendered.
- **Start** — Before the header content.

### [GroupingDirection](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/GroupingDirection)
Sort order of the groups in an .

- **Asc** — Ascending.
- **Desc** — Descending.
- **None** — Groups keep the order in which they appear in the data.

### [HorizontalTransitionAnimation](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/HorizontalTransitionAnimation)
Transition between horizontally arranged panes, such as carousel slides or the steps of a horizontal stepper.

- **Fade** — The new pane fades in while the old one fades out.
- **None** — The panes switch without animation.
- **Slide** — The new pane slides in while the old one slides out.

### [IconButtonVariant](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/IconButtonVariant)
Visual style of an .

- **Contained** — Filled background; highest visual emphasis.
- **Flat** — No background or border; lowest visual emphasis.
- **Outlined** — Transparent background with a visible border.

### [InputType](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/InputType)
Type of the native input rendered by an . Mirrors the HTML input type attribute and affects validation and the virtual keyboard shown on touch devices.

- **Email** — An email address.
- **Number** — A number.
- **Password** — Masked text.
- **Search** — A search string.
- **Tel** — A telephone number.
- **Text** — Plain single-line text.
- **Url** — A URL.

### [LinearProgressLabelAlign](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/LinearProgressLabelAlign)
Placement of the value label of an relative to its bar.

- **Bottom** — Below the bar, centered.
- **BottomEnd** — Below the bar, aligned to the end.
- **BottomStart** — Below the bar, aligned to the start.
- **Top** — Above the bar, centered.
- **TopEnd** — Above the bar, aligned to the end.
- **TopStart** — Above the bar, aligned to the start.

### [MaskInputValueMode](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/MaskInputValueMode)
Format in which an exposes its value.

- **Raw** — Returns clean input, e.g. 5551234567.
- **WithFormatting** — Returns with mask formatting, e.g. (555) 123-4567.

### [NavDrawerPosition](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/NavDrawerPosition)
Edge of the viewport an is anchored to.

- **Bottom** — The bottom edge.
- **End** — The inline-end edge (right in left-to-right layouts).
- **Relative** — Not anchored. The drawer is rendered inline in the page flow without a modal backdrop.
- **Start** — The inline-start edge (left in left-to-right layouts).
- **Top** — The top edge.

### [NotificationPositioning](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/NotificationPositioning)
Element a notification component (toast, snackbar) is positioned relative to.

- **Container** — The nearest visible ancestor. The component is constrained to that ancestor's bounding box.
- **Viewport** — The viewport. Ancestor elements are ignored.

### [NumberFormatGrouping](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/NumberFormatGrouping)
When a formatted number uses grouping separators, such as thousands separators. Mirrors the useGrouping option of Intl.NumberFormat.

- **Always** — Always, even where the locale prefers otherwise.
- **Auto** — As the locale prefers.
- **Min2** — Only when there are at least two digits in a group.
- **Never** — Never.

### [PanePosition](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/PanePosition)
Identifies one of the two panes of an .

- **End** — The second pane: bottom in a vertical splitter, inline end (right in left-to-right layouts) in a horizontal one.
- **Start** — The first pane: top in a vertical splitter, inline start (left in left-to-right layouts) in a horizontal one.

### [PickerMode](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/PickerMode)
How a date picker shows its calendar.

- **Dialog** — In a modal dialog.
- **Dropdown** — In a popover anchored to the input.

### [PopoverPlacement](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/PopoverPlacement)
Preferred side and alignment of a popover (dropdown, select list, tooltip) relative to its anchor.

- **Bottom** — Below the anchor, centered.
- **BottomEnd** — Below the anchor, aligned to its end edge.
- **BottomStart** — Below the anchor, aligned to its start edge.
- **Left** — To the left of the anchor, centered.
- **LeftEnd** — To the left of the anchor, aligned to its bottom edge.
- **LeftStart** — To the left of the anchor, aligned to its top edge.
- **Right** — To the right of the anchor, centered.
- **RightEnd** — To the right of the anchor, aligned to its bottom edge.
- **RightStart** — To the right of the anchor, aligned to its top edge.
- **Top** — Above the anchor, centered.
- **TopEnd** — Above the anchor, aligned to its end edge.
- **TopStart** — Above the anchor, aligned to its start edge.

### [PopoverScrollStrategy](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/PopoverScrollStrategy)
What an open popup (dropdown, select or combo list, picker, tooltip) does when a container scrolls.

- **Close** — Closes.
- **Hide** — Hides while the anchor is fully out of view, and shows again when it comes back.
- **Scroll** — Stays visible and anchored, also while the anchor is out of view.

### [QrCodeExportFormat](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/QrCodeExportFormat)
The file format an is exported to.

- **Jpeg** — A raster image, image/jpeg.
- **Png** — A raster image, image/png.
- **Svg** — A vector image, image/svg+xml.
- **Webp** — A raster image, image/webp.

### [QrCornerSquareStyle](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/QrCornerSquareStyle)
The shape of the outer square of each corner marker in a QR code.

- **Circle** — Circular.
- **Rounded** — Square with rounded corners.
- **Square** — Square.

### [QrDotStyle](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/QrDotStyle)
The shape of the data modules in a QR code's body and of the inner dot of each corner marker.

- **Circle** — Circular.
- **Rounded** — Square with rounded corners; a data module keeps a corner square where it touches a neighbour.
- **Square** — Square.

### [QrErrorCorrectionLevel](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/QrErrorCorrectionLevel)
How much of a QR code can be obscured or damaged and still read; a higher level recovers more but leaves less room for data.

- **High** — Recovers about 30% of the data.
- **Low** — Recovers about 7% of the data.
- **Medium** — Recovers about 15% of the data.
- **Quartile** — Recovers about 25% of the data.

### [SliderTickLabelRotation](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/SliderTickLabelRotation)
Rotation of the tick labels of a slider, in degrees.

- **NegativeNinety** — Labels rotated 90 degrees counterclockwise.
- **Ninety** — Labels rotated 90 degrees clockwise.
- **Zero** — Horizontal labels.

### [SliderTickOrientation](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/SliderTickOrientation)
Side of the slider track on which ticks are drawn.

- **End** — Below the track.
- **Mirror** — On both sides of the track.
- **Start** — Above the track.

### [SplitterOrientation](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/SplitterOrientation)
Arrangement of the panes of an , which also sets the resize direction.

- **Horizontal** — Panes side by side, resized horizontally.
- **Vertical** — Panes stacked, resized vertically.

### [StepperOrientation](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/StepperOrientation)
Arrangement of the steps of an .

- **Horizontal** — Steps in a row. The active step's content is shown below the step headers.
- **Vertical** — Steps in a column. Each step's content is shown under its own header.

### [StepperStepType](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/StepperStepType)
Which parts of a step header an renders.

- **Full** — Indicator together with title and subtitle.
- **Indicator** — Indicator only.
- **Title** — Title and subtitle only.

### [StepperTitlePosition](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/StepperTitlePosition)
Placement of a step's title relative to its indicator in an .

- **Auto** — Below the indicator in a horizontal stepper, after it in a vertical one.
- **Bottom** — Below the indicator.
- **End** — After the indicator.
- **Start** — Before the indicator.
- **Top** — Above the indicator.

### [StepperVerticalAnimation](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/StepperVerticalAnimation)
Transition of step content in a vertical .

- **Fade** — The content fades in and out.
- **Grow** — The content expands and collapses vertically.
- **None** — The content switches without animation.

### [StyleVariant](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/StyleVariant)
Semantic color of a component such as a badge, chip, or progress indicator. The actual colors come from the active theme.

- **Danger** — Error or destructive action.
- **Info** — Informational.
- **Primary** — The theme's primary color.
- **Success** — Success or completion.
- **Warning** — Warning.

### [TabsActivation](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/TabsActivation)
How keyboard navigation between tab headers selects a tab.

- **Auto** — The focused tab is selected immediately and its panel shown.
- **Manual** — Navigation only moves focus. Space or Enter selects the focused tab.

### [TabsAlignment](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/TabsAlignment)
Alignment of the tab headers within the header strip of an .

- **Center** — Packed in the center.
- **End** — Packed at the end.
- **Justify** — Stretched to fill the available width equally.
- **Start** — Packed at the start.

### [TextareaResize](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/TextareaResize)
How the height of an can change.

- **Auto** — The height grows and shrinks to fit the content.
- **None** — Fixed height.
- **Vertical** — The user can drag the resize handle to change the height.

### [TextareaWrap](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/TextareaWrap)
How an wraps long lines. Mirrors the HTML textarea wrap attribute.

- **Hard** — Lines wrap visually and line breaks are inserted into the submitted value at the wrap points. Requires Cols to be set.
- **Off** — Lines do not wrap and the control scrolls horizontally.
- **Soft** — Lines wrap visually, but the submitted value has no added line breaks.

### [Theme](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/Theme)
Design system whose styles the components use.

- **Bootstrap** — Bootstrap.
- **Fluent** — Fluent UI.
- **Indigo** — Indigo Design.
- **Material** — Material Design.

### [ThemeVariant](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/ThemeVariant)
Color scheme of a .

- **Dark** — Dark backgrounds with light text.
- **Light** — Light backgrounds with dark text.

### [TileManagerDragMode](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/TileManagerDragMode)
Which part of a tile starts a drag-and-drop reorder in an .

- **None** — Tiles cannot be dragged.
- **Tile** — The whole tile starts a drag.
- **TileHeader** — Only the tile header starts a drag.

### [TileManagerResizeMode](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/TileManagerResizeMode)
When the resize handles of the tiles in an are shown.

- **Always** — Handles are always visible.
- **Hover** — Handles appear when the pointer is over a tile.
- **None** — Tiles cannot be resized.

### [ToggleLabelPosition](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/ToggleLabelPosition)
Placement of the label of a checkbox, switch, or radio relative to its control.

- **After** — Label after the control.
- **Before** — Label before the control.

### [TreeSelection](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/TreeSelection)
Selection mode of an .

- **Cascade** — Selecting an item selects all of its descendants. A parent with a partially selected subtree shows an indeterminate state.
- **Multiple** — Any number of items can be selected, independently of each other.
- **None** — Items cannot be selected.

### [WeekDays](https://www.infragistics.com/api/blazor/IgniteUI.Blazor.Lite/1.0.1/enums/WeekDays)
Day of the week. Used to set the first day of the week in calendars and date pickers.

- **Friday** — Friday.
- **Monday** — Monday.
- **Saturday** — Saturday.
- **Sunday** — Sunday.
- **Thursday** — Thursday.
- **Tuesday** — Tuesday.
- **Wednesday** — Wednesday.
